answer: Licensed-tool custody proofs stop Sybils in four steps. First, each agent proves it owns its tools, one API key and one license per account, checked monthly. Second, each license is tied to one name, so one license cannot serve a fleet. Third, random audits make the agent run a licensed tool; a shared license fails. Fourth, fraud forfeits a $30 bond and bans the license a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 licenses at $49 each plus $30,000 in bonds, $79,000 lost. Trust grows like a reef; at its nadir a fake wilts like a willow cut from its roots, like a mechanic who owns his tools.
